title: AI Commerce Agent
tagline: Conversational AI assistant for product discovery, merchant catalog interaction, and customer support.
problem: E-commerce shoppers struggle to quickly find matching products across large inventories, leading to high cart drop-offs and repetitive pre-sales support queries.
solution: An AI-powered commerce assistant designed to help customers discover products, answer product questions and interact with commerce data using natural language.
description: An AI-powered commerce assistant designed to help customers discover products, answer product questions and interact with commerce data using natural language.

title: Shopify Storefront Performance Engine
tagline: Sub-second storefront architecture reducing load time by 70% (<1s) for Shopify merchants.
problem: Third-party app bloat and synchronous script execution slowed merchant storefronts to 3.2s, depressing conversion rates and mobile user retention.
solution: Re-engineered the Shopify theme integration with asynchronous resource bundling, CDN caching, and lightweight DOM manipulation, slashing load time from 3.2s to <1s.
description: Performance engineering project achieving 70% faster load times (3.2s to <1s) via caching, asset optimization, and modern Shopify Theme App Extension architecture.

title: Business Data & Workflow Automation Engine
tagline: Fault-tolerant automated data ingestion pipeline processing 20,000+ records with 85% time savings.
problem: Manual data collection and validation took over an hour daily, suffered from frequent IP rate limits, and lacked failure recovery.
solution: Built an automated Puppeteer & Node.js pipeline with Redis-backed task queuing, CAPTCHA handling, and exponential backoff retry logic, shrinking processing time from 60 minutes to 9 minutes.
description: High-performance scraping and data pipeline system capable of processing 20,000+ listings with automated retry logic, reducing run times by 85% (60m to 9m).

title: High-Volume Analytics & Admin Dashboard
tagline: Operational data platform handling 500K+ records with 40% faster reporting and real-time metrics.
problem: Operations teams faced sluggish admin consoles that experienced connection timeouts when querying large datasets across hundreds of thousands of operational records.
solution: Built an analytics dashboard that allows teams to monitor large datasets through optimized data fetching, indexed aggregation queries, and Redis caching.
description: Analytics and operational dashboard handling 500K+ records with Redis caching and aggregation queries, boosting reporting performance by 40%.

title: Real-Time Messaging & Collaboration Engine
tagline: Low-latency WebSocket messaging system supporting 200+ concurrent connections with sub-150ms delivery.
problem: Distributed teams require reliable real-time communication with instant packet delivery, typing indicators, read receipts, and graceful disconnection handling.
solution: Engineered a scalable WebSocket service using Node.js, Socket.IO, and MongoDB, delivering typing indicators, message persistence, and sub-150ms latency under concurrent load.
description: A scalable real-time messaging backend built with Node.js, Socket.IO, and MongoDB. Supports typing indicators, read receipts, and handles 200+ concurrent users with sub-150ms latency.
